name: Web Clone
description: Snapshot a live web page — HTML + all CSS/JS/image/font assets — into a self-contained file or a directory bundle, with optional component extraction and framework codegen; --convert re-runs extraction/codegen on a saved snapshot. Adds a /web-clone slash command.
author: cognia-next

networkAccess.reasoning: /web-clone snapshots whatever page the user names, so the host is only known at runtime. The snapshot runs through the host's web_clone tool, which keeps the SSRF private-host guard and the user's opt-in for it.

browser.reason: The snapshot engine is a Node process reached via a Tauri command; it does not exist in the browser build.

mobile.reason: No sidecar / Tauri command host in the mobile WebView.

headless.reason: The snapshot engine is spawned by the Tauri command host; a headless server has no invoke bridge for it. The agent-facing web_clone tools work there via the sidecar instead.

commands.name: /web-clone
commands.description: Snapshot a web page into the workspace.

en.manifest.name: Web Clone
en.manifest.description: Snapshot a live web page — HTML + all CSS/JS/image/font assets — into a self-contained file or a directory bundle, with optional component extraction and framework codegen; --convert re-runs extraction/codegen on a saved snapshot. Adds a /web-clone slash command.
en.intro: Snapshot a web page to disk.
en.desktopOnly: web-clone runs only on the desktop app.
en.noWorkspace: no open project — open a project folder, or pass an absolute path
en.outsideWorkspace: "{path}" must stay inside the workspace — remove the ".." segments, or pass a full absolute path
en.tildeUnsupported: "{path}" uses ~ which is not expanded — pass a full absolute path
en.convertWithUrl: --convert re-runs codegen on a saved snapshot — drop the URL argument
en.cancelled: web-clone was cancelled. A snapshot already started keeps running until its own timeout; its output may still appear in the target folder.
en.resultSnapshotIssues: Snapshot written to {output} ({fetched}/{total} fetched, {failed} failed, {skipped} skipped).
en.failedPrivateHost: web-clone failed: {error} Pass --private to allow private/loopback targets.
en.commands.web-clone.description: Snapshot a web page into the workspace.

zh-CN.manifest.name: 网页克隆
zh-CN.manifest.description: 把在线网页——HTML 及所有 CSS/JS/图片/字体资源——保存为独立文件或目录包，可选组件提取与框架代码生成；--convert 可对已保存的快照重新提取和生成。提供 /web-clone 命令。
zh-CN.intro: 将网页快照保存到磁盘。
zh-CN.usage: 用法：/web-clone <url> | --convert <路径> [-o <输出>] [-m single|bundle] [--framework vue|react|angular|svelte|jquery] [--framework-hint vue|react|svelte] [--extract-components] [--drafts] [--extract-shared] [--no-typescript] [--max-assets <n>] [--concurrency <n>] [--timeout <毫秒>] [--max-file-size <字节>] [--pretty] [--private]
zh-CN.desktopOnly: web-clone 仅可在桌面端运行。
zh-CN.noWorkspace: 没有打开的项目——请打开一个项目文件夹，或传入绝对路径
zh-CN.outsideWorkspace: "{path}" 必须位于工作区内——请去掉 ".." 段，或传入完整绝对路径
zh-CN.tildeUnsupported: "{path}" 中的 ~ 不会被展开——请传入完整绝对路径
zh-CN.convertWithUrl: --convert 用于对已保存的快照重跑 codegen——请去掉 URL 参数
zh-CN.progressConvert: 正在转换已保存的快照…
zh-CN.cancelled: web-clone 已取消。已开始的快照会继续运行直到自身超时，其输出仍可能出现在目标文件夹中。
zh-CN.resultSnapshot: 快照已写入 {output}（已获取 {fetched}/{total} 个资源）。
zh-CN.resultSnapshotIssues: 快照已写入 {output}（{fetched}/{total} 成功，{failed} 失败，{skipped} 跳过）。
zh-CN.failedPrivateHost: web-clone 失败：{error}（可加 --private 允许内网/本机地址）
zh-CN.commands.web-clone.description: 把网页快照保存到工作区。
